name: NPPA anti-diabetic ceiling-price formulations (March 2026)
attribution_text: Source: National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority, Government of India; anti-diabetic ceiling-price formulations, as on March 2026.
transformation_method: Human-reviewed PDF table transcription to committed CSV, then deterministic CSV-to-package conversion.
notes: NPPA-authored formulation facts only. Brand, manufacturer, diagnosis, dosing and substitution information are not inferred. Ceiling-price facts remain in raw source metadata and are not shown to patients. source_updated_at records the official PDF HTTP Last-Modified date observed on accessed_at.
